name: Totalitarianism
notAnIdeology: Totalitarianism is an analytic category of regime (a system of government that controls public and private life, per Arendt, Friedrich and Brzezinski), not a set of beliefs that adherents profess; regimes so labelled held opposed ideologies (Stalinism, Nazism, Fascist Italy), which are covered by their own entries such as fascism.
